import numpy as np
def _kin(seed, scale=0.08):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    A = rng.normal(size=(3, 3)) * scale
    Ffull = np.eye(3) + A
    v = rng.normal(size=3); N = v / np.linalg.norm(v)
    nn = np.linalg.inv(Ffull).T @ N; n = nn / np.linalg.norm(nn)
    Grad_u = A
    grad_u = np.eye(3) - np.linalg.inv(Ffull)
    tt = rng.normal(size=3); tt = tt - np.dot(tt, N) * N; tt = tt / np.linalg.norm(tt)
    gphi = rng.normal(size=3)
    return N, n, tt, gphi, Grad_u, grad_u, rng
N, n, tt, gphi, Grad_u, grad_u, rng = _kin(1, 0.08)
assert np.allclose(tdc_surface_frame(N, tt), target)

    A = rng.normal(size=(3, 3)) * scale
    Ffull = np.eye(3) + A
    v = rng.normal(size=3); N = v / np.linalg.norm(v)
    nn = np.linalg.inv(Ffull).T @ N; n = nn / np.linalg.norm(nn)
    Grad_u = A
    grad_u = np.eye(3) - np.linalg.inv(Ffull)
    tt = rng.normal(size=3); tt = tt - np.dot(tt, N) * N; tt = tt / np.linalg.norm(tt)
    gphi = rng.normal(size=3)
    return N, n, tt, gphi, Grad_u, grad_u, rng

AL_M = [1.3, 5.0, -2.0]
MU_F = [0.4225]
AL_F = [2.0]

assert np.allclose(tdc_coupled_energy(N, n, tt, gphi, Grad_u, grad_u, T, MU_M, AL_M, MU_F, AL_F).ravel(), target)
